concept.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE NEW utility spacecraft for the OpenFA isometric RTS, as a simple practical reference for a 3D GAME UNIT. Both supplied images are actual existing 3D SHIPS OF THIS CULTURE from the gallery. Use their characteristic material finish, colour distribution, structural vocabulary and component integration. This should belong naturally beside them. Do not copy weapons or recreate either reference unit. Mechanisms for the new engineering role are authored OpenFA extensions.
Critical design target: a clear compact game silhouette at 64-96 pixels wide; roughly 4-7 major masses, only a few moving parts and large quiet surfaces. Simple does not mean rounded toy. Keep the structural character of the supplied culture. Do not add miniature machinery, cabling, greebles, rivet fields, small vents everywhere, rails, ladders, antennas, cargo racks, light arrays, cockpit interiors or intricate ornament. Restrained game-render shading, big readable highlights; not a cinematic machinery illustration. No universal human construction-vehicle chassis, no compulsory twin side engine pods, no bronze nozzle rims unless present in the supplied faction references, no generic two front elbow-arms layout. Propulsion may be flush with the hull or integrated into supports.
One complete SPACECRAFT, isolated on perfectly pure black, elevated front three-quarter view showing its tool, all silhouette and tool extremities comfortably inside frame. Entire image is one individual deliverable, not a contact sheet. No terrain, floor, scenery, people, text, labels, logos, watermark, weapons, wheels, tracks, walking legs, smoke, sparks or fantastical floating parts. Subtle material-specific seam dirt, tool abrasion, a few edge scratches or small dents; preserve the faction's actual paint/alloy surface rather than applying uniform scratched grey metal to everything.
ACHAEAN family: a warm copper/salmon elongated central body with slender cool silver-edged curved structures and dark russet inset panels. Use the flowing structure and material distribution in the supplied actual models. Silver crescent elements are THIN compared with the central hull, not thick padded engine nacelles. Do not force pointed fighter wings or copy a combat silhouette; interpret the culture for industry. Warm satin metal and muted enamel, restrained wear on tool contact edges. No human truck cabin, no golden rings on standard Terran engines, no palace or onion-domed building shapes.
Subject: REPAIR AND CONSTRUCTION-ASSIST SHIP. A short elongated copper/salmon service capsule with one slender silver crescent collar sweeping from one side around the rear to the other, containing dark red inserts and flush thrust slots at its roots. ONE curved underslung service boom follows the belly and ends forward in a simple small bifurcated lifting/assembly clamp with a short adjacent joining nozzle. This single tool assembly both aligns panels and welds buildings. No paired elbow arms, no two bulky engine gondoles, no tractor cab. Small dark control/sensor inset flush to nose, no towers. Only 4-5 major shapes, flowing but industrial and compact.
